tasks.title: HANGS Construction Services · FY2026 Loan Covenant Procedures
tasks.description: Perform the agreed-upon procedures Cinderbrook Bank and HANGS Construction Services LLC agreed for the June 30, 2026 covenant test from 11 PDF and Excel files: the engagement letter, the loan agreement’s facilities, reporting and Section 7 covenants, the trial balance and financial statements, the receivables aging, the contract schedule, the debt schedule, the bank’s loan confirmation, the fixed asset register and the compliance certificate. Agree the figures, compute working capital, tangible net worth, leverage and capital expenditures as the agreement defines them, test the reporting dates and compare the certificate. Produce formula-linked workpapers with tickmarks and draft findings. The CPA reviews and issues the report; the machine gives no opinion or conclusion.
